pro_course_detail.title: Modern Standard Arabic (Intermediate and Advanced)
pro_course_detail.description: This is a class for remedial, intermediate and advanced learners who wish to take their Arabic to the next level. This class is objective based: together we identify what your objectives and level are and decide on a strategy for moving forward. Whether you wish to prepare for a specific exam, learn how to read Arabic texts, listen to Arabic media and songs, or catch back up when you have fallen behind in your Arabic college class, this is the place to be.

pro_course_detail.title: Introduction to Arabic: Arabic Sound System and Script (Beginner and Remedial)
pro_course_detail.description: This is a class that will help you establish the foundations for learning Arabic.  In 3-5 classes you will be able to recognize and produce the different sounds of Arabic, match sounds to letters, recognize the different forms of Arabic letters in isolation and in cursive, and read basic words. This basic knowledge of Arabic is necessary to making any meaningful progress learning the language whether your ultimate objective is to communicate fluently in Arabic: reading, writing, listening and speaking, or to achieve an acceptable level of proficiency in conversational Arabic.

pro_course_detail.title: South Levantine Arabic (Palestinian/Jordanian Dialects)
pro_course_detail.description: This class will help you recognize the different varieties within the Jordanian and Palestinian dialects. Despite the fact that these two dialects are distinct and consist of nuanced variations, there are numerous similarities, thus the term "South Levantine Arabic". I am a Jordanian of Palestinian origin; I have lived and worked in the vibrant city of Amman, the capital of Jordan, most of my life; therefore, I have always been surrounded by the different varieties within these two dialects.

teacher_info.introduction:
大家好！我中文名字叫小山，来自意大利，属龙，今年28岁了。 2012年，我在意大利罗马大学东方学院以优异的成绩本科毕业了，并继续攻读硕士学位。 虽然我对中文很感兴趣，但是在大学我的专业是日语。我学习了5年日语，说得比中文好一点儿。我已经通过了汉语水平五级和日语二级的考试，也就是说都快要达到最高水平了。我几年前去过日本，在东京外国语大学留学了一年，然后去中国天津外国语大学留学了一个学期。在罗马的一个学校参加过对外国孩子意大利语的培训；在日本当过意大利语培训班的老师；校对了一本意日词典；我还当过东京外国语大学意大利语系教授的助手；在中国天津的一家艺术贸易公司当过翻译；回国以后在罗马华文学校当意大利语和英语老师。

Hello there! my name is Cosimo. My major is oriental languages. I speak fluent Chinese and Japanese. Now I’m attending a MA in education while teaching English and Italian to Chinese people in a language school. I have started my career with an apprenticeship at a primary school in Rome in which I was trained to teach Italian language to foreign children. Then I have worked as an Italian teacher in an international school in Tokyo and have some teaching experience even in Tokyo University of foreign studies.

 皆さんこんにちは！コジモと言います。1988年生まれ、今年28歳です。 2012年3月、ローマ大学東洋研究学部日本語専攻を最優秀の成績で卒業しました。卒論のテーマは「自己啓発書の小説」でした。今、大学院生で万事順調であれば2014年3月以内卒業する予定です。外国語のレベルと獲得した資格は: TOEFL英語検定試験，日本語検定の２級（最高レベル１級） 中国語検定の5級（最高レベル６級） つまり英語、日本語と中国語が同等に高いレベルで話すことができます。 職歴になりますが、二年生の時ローマのある小学校で外国人の子供にイタリア語を教えるための研修を受けて、大学主催の交流留学プログラムに参加し、東京外国語大学で一年間ほど勉強することになりました。日本留学の際、大学のイタリア語の教授の補助、東京都武蔵野市国際交流協会のイタリア語教室の講師、白水社によって出版された意日辞典の校正しました。帰国してから「チャイニーズ・ブリッジ」という中国語国際大会に参加し、銅メダルを獲得しました。その後、再び留学し、中国天津外国語大学で2012年の冬学期を過ごしました。そこで中国語のレベルアップを図りながら、天津にある芸術品貿易会社で中伊通訳家として勤めていました。最後に、ローマに戻ってから今に至るまで、言語学校で中国の方にイタリア語と英語を教えています。

My first experience was in the Philippines. I was a volunteer sent by the Japanese government and taught at the Foreign Service Institute of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.  My students at that time were all adults mainly government officials.  
After that I went to New Zealand to continue teaching Japanese at a university and also secondary schools.

Upon returning to Japan, I taught English to the young Japanese volunteers who were going out to some developing countries for their tasks.

Aside from the many years of teaching experiences, my knowledge of multiple languages helps understand the students' psychology and I can help them effectively.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons are various depending on a student.  I try to cater the student's need and likes.

Many of my students are focusing on their speaking ability.  So they prepare their topics to talk about.  Some students like to read a Japanese novels, so we read the same book together and discuss about the book in class.  Some students write essays before the class and we discuss the writing.

The speed of class is also varies.  Some students want to take their time, so we go slow.  Some others are eager to learn as much as possible in a short time, so we go very fast. 

Some students find most of the existing Japanese textbooks boring, so they find some other reading materials, like Manga!

To boost students' Arabic speaking skills📈, I use a variety of fun and effective strategies designed to build confidence, fluency, and accuracy:

1. Structured Conversation Practice: I provide guided conversation prompts and topics, helping students expand their vocabulary, practice new language structures, and gain confidence in expressing themselves in Arabic.

2. Role-Playing Activities: I organize role-playing scenarios that mimic real-life situations, like ordering food at a restaurant, making travel arrangements, or engaging in social interactions. This helps students apply language skills in context and develop communication strategies for everyday scenarios.

3. Error Correction and Feedback: I offer constructive feedback and correction during speaking activities to help students identify and fix errors in pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary usage. By providing specific guidance and encouragement, I create a supportive learning environment that fosters improvement.

4. Vocabulary Expansion Exercises: I incorporate vocabulary-building exercises and drills to help students expand their Arabic lexicon, including common phrases, idiomatic expressions, and specialized vocabulary relevant to their interests or professional fields.

5. Pronunciation Practice: I dedicate time to pronunciation practice, focusing on mastering Arabic sounds, intonation patterns, and stress patterns. Through repetition, modeling, and guided practice, students learn to produce sounds accurately and develop clear and comprehensible speech. 📈

6. Authentic Materials and Resources: I use authentic audiovisual materials, like videos, podcasts, and news articles, to provide real-world context and exposure to the language.

By implementing these strategies, I create a dynamic and engaging learning environment that supports students' language development and empowers them to become confident speakers.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description: Welcome to our General English lessons, designed to help you improve your reading, writing, and speaking skills across A1 to B2 levels. Our program is tailored to meet your needs, whether you're a beginner or looking to enhance your proficiency. At the A1 level, you'll start with basic sentence construction, simple texts, and everyday conversations, gradually building confidence and vocabulary. Moving to A2, you'll engage with slightly longer texts, write short paragraphs, and participate in everyday conversations, enhancing your ability to express preferences and describe daily activities. At the B1 level, you'll tackle intermediate texts, write coherent paragraphs, and engage in discussions, focusing on expressing opinions and improving fluency. Finally, at the B2 level, you'll read advanced texts, write essays and reports, and participate in complex discussions, enhancing your ability to speak fluently and accurately. Our interactive lessons use real-life scenarios, providing personalized feedback and assessments to track your progress. You'll have access to comprehensive materials, a language lab for pronunciation practice, and personalized tutoring sessions. Join our General English program to start your journey towards mastering the English language, with flexible scheduling and a comprehensive curriculum designed to help you achieve your language goals for travel, study, or career advancement. Enroll now and take the first step towards fluency!

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description: Our IELTS Exam Preparation course is designed to equip students with the necessary skills and strategies to excel in all four components of the IELTS exam: Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking. The course begins with a diagnostic test to identify each student's strengths and areas for improvement, allowing for a tailored teaching approach. We focus on building listening skills through diverse audio materials and enhancing reading comprehension with various texts, teaching techniques such as skimming, scanning, and detailed reading. Writing practice emphasizes essay structure, coherence, and grammar, while speaking sessions include mock interviews to improve fluency and pronunciation. Utilizing official IELTS practice tests and materials, we ensure students are familiar with the test format and question types. Additionally, we teach time management skills and provide detailed feedback on practice exercises. Regular practice, vocabulary building, and stress management techniques are integrated into the course to boost confidence and performance. Enroll now to benefit from personalized feedback, comprehensive test preparation, and the structured support needed to succeed in the IELTS exam.

pro_course_detail.title: Essential English Foundations
pro_course_detail.description: Welcome to **Essential English Foundations**, a comprehensive course designed to provide learners with a solid grounding in the basics of the English language. This course is ideal for complete beginners or those looking to refresh their knowledge. Throughout the course, you will master the 26 letters of the English alphabet and their pronunciation, construct simple sentences using subject, verb, and object, and expand your vocabulary with common words related to colors, numbers, days of the week, and months. You will also learn basic adjectives, common greetings, and expressions to initiate and maintain conversations, as well as how to ask and answer basic questions. Additionally, you will develop an understanding of subject and object pronouns, apply simple present tense grammar rules, and navigate prepositions of place to describe locations. By the end of this course, you will be able to recognize and pronounce all letters of the English alphabet, form simple sentences, engage in basic conversations, describe locations using prepositions, and confidently use pronouns and essential verbs in everyday communication. Join us on this journey to build a strong foundation in English and take your first step towards mastering the language!

pro_course_detail.title: Arabic for Travelers: Essential Language and Culture Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
Preparing for travel with Arabic involves tailored lessons that focus on practical language skills and cultural knowledge. My lessons are designed to equip students with essential vocabulary and phrases for various travel scenarios, such as navigating airports, booking accommodations, ordering food, and asking for directions.

I start with key phrases and expressions that travelers frequently use, including greetings, polite requests, and common questions. These basics help students communicate effectively in everyday situations.

To simulate real-life scenarios, I use role-plays that cover activities like checking into a hotel, asking for recommendations, or shopping at local markets. These exercises build confidence and help students practice language in context.

Understanding local customs and etiquette is crucial for a positive travel experience. I include lessons on cultural norms, dining etiquette, and appropriate behavior to help students interact respectfully and smoothly with native speakers.

I incorporate interactive tools such as digital flashcards, listening exercises, and language apps to reinforce vocabulary and improve pronunciation. These resources make learning engaging and practical.

I also provide students with tips on how to handle common travel challenges, like understanding local accents, using public transportation, and dealing with emergencies. This preparation ensures they feel ready and comfortable during their travels.

Overall, my travel preparation lessons aim to make students feel confident and capable of navigating Arabic-speaking environments, enhancing their travel experience with effective communication and cultural understanding.

pro_course_detail.description:
Teaching Arabic to kids aged 11-16 involves creating engaging and age-appropriate lessons that foster both language skills and a love for learning. 

For this age group, my approach includes interactive and dynamic activities tailored to their interests and developmental stages.
